access.lockedHint: Production connection: writing is always locked.

statusbar.label: Status bar
statusbar.offline: The local server does not answer.

start.title: Welcome
start.lead: Tabrion Studio is a local developer tool for SQLite and PostgreSQL databases. It runs on this computer only and is read-only by default.
start.projectsBody: Run tabrion-studio in a project folder to work with its connection profiles. The project and connection views arrive with the next versions.

connections.title: Connections
connections.lead: Your profiles are saved in Studio's own profiles.toml (0600). Project profiles come from the project's .tabrion/studio.toml, which Studio never changes.
connections.emptyBody: Create a profile for a SQLite file or a PostgreSQL database. Studio stays read-only.
connections.unavailable: The profiles could not be loaded.
connections.userIssues: Your profiles.toml has issues, so Studio does not change it. Fix these in the file:
connections.projectHint: From the project file. Edit .tabrion/studio.toml in the project to change it.

detail.label: Details of {{name}}
detail.readOnlyRole: Role should not be able to write (checked by diagnostics)
detail.needsRegistry: Testing and connecting arrive with the database connection in the next version.

wizard.description: Studio saves the profile in your profiles.toml. Passwords never go into the file.
wizard.pathHint: The full path of the database file. SQLite is always opened read-only (mode=ro).
wizard.sourceKeyringMissing: System keyring (not available on this computer)
wizard.filePathHint: A file that only you can read (0600). A relative path starts in Studio's configuration folder.
wizard.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
wizard.passwordOptional: Optional: Studio can also ask when connecting.
wizard.name: Name
wizard.readOnlyRole: The role should have no write privileges (diagnostics checks it)
wizard.savedIn: Saved in your profiles (profiles.toml). Studio does not change the project file.
wizard.testLater: The connection test arrives with the database connection in the next version.
wizard.handWritten: Your profiles.toml was written by hand. Saving rewrites it; its comments and formatting are not kept.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The profile is removed from your profiles.toml, and a saved password from the keyring.

password.title: Password for {{name}}
password.body: Studio uses the password only when it connects. It is never shown again.
password.keyringMissing: In the system keyring (not available on this computer)

connections.secretNotSaved: {{name}} saved, but the password was not: {{reason}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.saved: Language, theme and density are stored in this browser. Queries and security are saved in Studio's settings.toml.
settings.logSql: Write SQL statements to the log
settings.logSqlWarning: The log then contains the statements you run, which can include data. Parameter values are never logged. Takes effect with the query engine.
settings.unavailable: The settings could not be loaded.
settings.fileIssues: Your settings.toml has issues, so Studio does not change it. Fix these in the file:
settings.handWritten: Your settings.toml was written by hand. Saving rewrites it; its comments are not kept.

session.title: Sign in to Tabrion Studio
session.used: This sign-in link was already used. Run tabrion-studio again to open Studio.
session.expired: This sign-in link has expired. Run tabrion-studio again to open Studio.
session.invalid: This sign-in link is not valid. Run tabrion-studio again to open Studio.
session.none: Not signed in. Run tabrion-studio in your project folder to open Studio.
session.offline: The local server does not answer. Run tabrion-studio again to open Studio.
session.ended: Your session has ended. Run tabrion-studio again to open Studio.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist in Tabrion Studio.

projectNotice.title: Project profiles not loaded
projectNotice.body: {{file}} cannot be used, so Studio does not load its profiles. Fix these issues in the file:

trustProject.title: Trust the project profiles?
trustProject.titleChanged: The project profiles have changed. Trust them?
trustProject.body_one: {{file}} defines {{count}} connection. Check these details before Studio connects.
trustProject.body_other: {{file}} defines {{count}} connections. Check these details before Studio connects.
trustProject.heading: {{label}} ({{count}})
trustProject.changes: Changes since you trusted the file
trustProject.noVisibleChange: No connection, host, file or variable changed; other content of the file did.
trustProject.connectionsRetargeted: Saved password not used (the connection now goes elsewhere; Studio asks for it again)
trustProject.stale: The file changed after it was shown. This is the new content: review it again before you trust it.

flowWarning.remote_host: sent to a host outside this computer
flowWarning.sensitive_variable: this variable usually holds another service's credential
flowWarning.secret_outside: password file outside the project folder

prodConnect.title: Production database
prodConnect.body: {{name}} is marked as PROD. Studio stays read-only; queries are limited to {{seconds}} s.

unsavedScript.title: Script not saved
unsavedScript.body: {{name}} has changes that are not saved.

issues.control_character: Contains a control character or a space.
issues.network_path: Network paths and devices are not allowed.
issues.not_for_engine: Not used by this database type.
issues.plain_password: Only a reference such as keyring: or env:NAME is allowed.

problems.config_stale: The file changed since the page read it. The page shows the current state; make the change again.
problems.config_invalid: The file has issues, so Studio does not rewrite it. Fix the issues in the file first.
problems.config_hand_written: The file was written by hand. Confirm to rewrite it.
problems.config_dir_unsafe: Studio's configuration folder is not private (it must be yours, mode 700, not a link).
problems.config_unwritable: Studio could not write the file.
problems.profile_invalid: Some fields are missing or not valid.
problems.profile_exists: Another of your profiles has this name.
problems.profile_read_only: Studio does not change the project's profile file.
problems.keyring_unavailable: There is no usable system keyring on this computer.
problems.keyring_failed: The system keyring did not complete the request.
problems.secret_invalid: The password is empty or too long.
problems.secret_not_storable: This profile takes its password from its own source.
problems.offline: The local server does not answer.
problems.config_too_large: The file would be larger than Studio reads (256 KB). Remove profiles you no longer use.
